# The PTX approximate forms on an RTX 3060 (sm_86, driver 610.88, nvcc 13.0.88, 2026-11-15), from tools/numerics/mufu_forms:
# "= <form>" starts a form; then "<operand bits> <result bits>" a line (div: "<a bits> <b bits> <result bits>"). The operands
# are those where ptxas puts more than one MUFU instruction around the form (subnormals, |x| above 2^126, x below -126),
# and the special values. tests/unit/test_mufu_model.cpp runs each form through the PTX interpreter and holds it to every line.
